eval: __game.stop(), 'stopped: Phase 4 design check of the contract stubs (PHASE4.md §10)'

expect: typeof __game.conditions === 'function' && typeof __game.setCondition === 'function' && __game.conditions().length === 4 && __game.conditions().every((c) => c.available === true) && 'four conditions, all available (switched on at the Phase 4 merge)'

expect: __game.env.dayNumber === -1 && __game.farm.condition === null && __game.farm.power.on === true && 'Phase 2 prep day, no condition, power on'

the stub rains in the rainy season's storm window

expect: __game.farm.power.on === false && __game.env.fansEffective === 0 && __game.env.fansManual === 6 && 'the power is off: no fans turn (the setting of six stays)'

expect: (__game.farm.problems.find((p) => p.id === 'power-cut') || {}).phase === 'found' && 'the cut is the power-cut alarm symptom'

expect: __game.farm.power.on === true && __game.farm.power.source === 'generator' && __game.env.fansManual === 6 && 'on the generator, six fans again'

expect: __game.env.weather === 'hot' && __game.env.weatherEvents.some((e) => /^sun-/.test(e.id)) && __game.env.dayNumber === 3 && (__game.farm.problems.find((p) => p.id === 'warm-afternoon') || {}).phase === 'ended' && 'hot: the sun on, the warm afternoon dropped'
label: setCondition installs the condition's weather, sun and problems

expect: __game.config.PHASE4.tunedSigns === true && __game.config.CONDITIONS.hot.sun.perH === 1.5 && 'the tuned sign lines on (switched on with the tuned model at the Phase 4 merge)'
